payload.agent_blocked_reason:
Two escalations, both needing code changes outside T05:
1. Module `specfuse/loop/ids.py`, `resolve` / `_has_folder`. Case: `FEAT-2026-0078` has a roadmap row and an `.specfuse/agent-policy.yml` queue entry but no feature folder. The rename re-keys the row to `FEAT-LOOP-2026-0078` and writes an alias, but `resolve` requires a folder for the target. It prints `WARNING: id-aliases.yml maps FEAT-2026-0078 to FEAT-LOOP-2026-0078, which has no feature folder` and returns the legacy ID. The post-rename validation then raises `ERROR: queue: 'FEAT-2026-0078' has no row in roadmap.md`, so the migrate exits 1 (AC1). `test_agent_policy_queue.TestLiveDogfoodFile.test_live_agent_policy_has_zero_errors` fails for the same reason. Fixing this means either letting `resolve` accept a target that has a roadmap row, or having the migration rewrite the policy queue. A test change would only hide it.
2. Schema `.specfuse/schemas/event.schema.json` (copy in `specfuse/loop/data/schemas/`). Case: `test_validate_event.TestValidateEventValid.test_driver_event_from_feat_0008_is_accepted`. After the rename, the real `events.jsonl` carries `FEAT-LOOP-2026-0008/T01`, which fails the `correlation_id` pattern `^FEAT-\d{4}-\d{4}(/...)?$`. A renamed tree's own events would fail `validate-event`. The schema pattern needs the optional key group. I did not edit the test, so it is not weakened.
Not a foreign-ID exclusion case; no `--exclude-id` needed.
Environment note: the rehearsal needs to run unsandboxed. In the sandbox it produced about 160 errors (git, build-dependency network fetch) that disappeared outside it. Running unsandboxed also needed more than 10 minutes, so the last rehearsal ran in the background.
